title: Nevermind deck plan
description: Input of `deck_helper.py plan-lint` and `scaffold`. The validator in deck_helper.py is hand-written and enforces this shape plus the design rules documented in references/deck-plan.md.

advisor.description: Turn on the representation advice in plan-lint (advisory A-codes, never errors). plan-advise works either way.

audience.description: Who reads the deck; experts get tables for exact values sooner

theme.description: Either a preset name from themes.json, custom tokens, or a preset plus overrides.

title.description: Short label used as data-title and in the overview grid

layout.description: short name (cover section split split-rev hero stat cards compare diagram timeline quote center list) or a real nm-l-* composition without the prefix (title, hero-figure, bento-4, cards-3, stat-row, rail, steps, ...)

content.description: Optional description of the slide's information (NM-29). plan-advise turns it into a suggested representation, acts and Morph. Absent: no advice, the tools behave as before.

items.description: How many elements the information has (steps, parts, points)

quantities.description: The numbers, in order; a chart visual is drawn from them

formula.description: true, or the formula itself (MathML or TeX) so --apply can write the equation

entities.description: Named things the slide talks about; shared with the previous slide they suggest Morph

ref.description: anatomy: figure name (needs <ref>.brief.json); image: intended file stem

diagram_type.description: nm-diagram data-type (flow tree cycle hub swimlane sequence timeline layers matrix funnel pyramid venn compare bars line donut gauge stat) or an alias (bar column area pie stack network graph kpi)

rows.description: table: body rows, each with one cell per column (8 rows x 6 columns at most to stay at 20px or more)

row_headers.description: table: the first column labels the rows (default true)

highlight.description: table: static emphasis, for example "r2 c3" (body row 2, data column 3)

caption.description: table or equation: a caption under the visual

mathml.description: equation: one native <math> element (the default, needs no library); data-term="x" on a part links it to the same term on the next slide

tex.description: equation: TeX without $ delimiters; scaffold stages the optional Temml converter. \data{term=x}{...} links a term

why.description: Why this representation (plan-advise --apply writes the reason here)

locked.description: plan-advise never changes a locked visual

lines.description: equation: a derivation, one formula per line with an optional note; step target visual:line reveals them in order

morph.description: Shared element ids carried from the previous slide. Conventional ids: title, kicker, visual, stat, body1..bodyN.

target.description: headline | kicker | visual | visual:<mode> (diagram: rank node edge series; table: row col; derivation: line) | stat | body | bodyN | node:<id> | any element id
